# Viewstate Consulting

> Independent IT consultancy in Dubai, UAE. Senior, hands-on IT expertise for companies that need more capability or IT leadership without a permanent IT manager. Led by Alejandro Abian (15+ years international IT; Europe, Japan, UAE).

Site: https://viewstate.co/  ·  Contact: contact@viewstate.co  ·  Book: https://bookings.cloud.microsoft/book/ViewstateConsulting@viewstate.co/
Languages: English, Spanish, Japanese. Serving Dubai, the UAE, the GCC, and remote international clients.
Engagement models: fixed-scope project, embedded senior support, ongoing advisory / interim IT management.
Last reviewed: 2026-10-27

## Services
- [Microsoft 365 consulting in Dubai](https://viewstate.co/microsoft-365-consulting-dubai/): Independent Microsoft 365 consulting in Dubai: tenant set-up, email migration, Entra ID and conditional access, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and ongoing remote administration.
- [IT infrastructure and operations consulting in Dubai](https://viewstate.co/it-infrastructure-support-dubai/): Hands-on IT infrastructure consulting in Dubai: VMware, Hyper-V and Proxmox virtualisation, Veeam backup and restore testing, UniFi networks, and security health checks.
- [IT project management and on-site technical leadership in Dubai](https://viewstate.co/it-project-management-dubai/): Senior on-site technical leadership for IT migrations, deployments, office moves and cutover weekends in Dubai. Also available to MSPs and consultancies under their brand.
- [Interim and part-time IT manager in Dubai](https://viewstate.co/interim-it-manager-dubai/): Interim and part-time IT management in Dubai for companies without an IT manager or between hires. Vendor oversight, IT set-up for new UAE offices, ITIL-aligned service processes.
- [Software asset management and technology cost review in Dubai](https://viewstate.co/software-asset-management-dubai/): Software Asset Management and technology cost review in Dubai: Microsoft 365, Adobe and Zoom licence reviews, renewal and procurement strategy, compliance and audit readiness.
- [AI consulting and adoption support in Dubai](https://viewstate.co/ai-consulting-dubai/): Practical AI adoption for Dubai companies: readiness review, rolling out Claude or ChatGPT with admin and data rules, workflow automation, and private self-hosted AI.
